title: The --review-record usage line says the Sonnet model rule covers only --fix-check
why: Retrospective 13:44 CST Nov 12: merge/merge.py line 26 ("MODEL must be sonnet on every record") reads as covering every round, but it covers only --fix-check; sessions choked on where to record a Haiku round 1.
note: Home: decision agent-model-cap. Reword the usage line to name --fix-check; a test pins the line. R9 and the code already settle the question; the retrospective answered runner 10 directly. S, one file. Taken by lane review-record-fix-check-reads (coordinator 13:59 CST Nov 12). Coordinator 18:57 CST Nov 12 (lane record-before-fix-push, #2979): `merge --review-record --fix-check` accepts sonnet only, so a haiku fix check could not be recorded. This adds to the haiku round-1 note: the usage line and the fix-check model rule must say where a haiku fix check is recorded, or that it is not allowed. Checked 20:15 CST Nov 12 (coordinator 20:14): decision agent-model-cap row "reviewer" is haiku for round 1, and the agent spawn guard refuses a sonnet round 1 (cull lane). Haiku round 1 is the table as ruled, not lane drift, so it becomes no new step. The usage-line fix stays: say where a haiku round 1 is recorded, and that a fix check is sonnet only (row "reviewer, rounds 2 and 3, or a fix check").
